story.title: The Great Tomato Launching Debacle
story.question: How did Barnaby's automatic tomato-slicer cause chaos at the farmers market?
story.answer: His machine targeted flying prices instead of produce, turning the central square into a red-tinted war zone.

story_beats.headline: The Grand Unveiling
story_beats.speech: Behold the turbo slicer! It dices any round vegetable instantly without a single drop of messy juice.
story_beats.label: The Invention
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby proudly stands next to his clunky brass robot-slicer in a bustling outdoor market, holding a clipboard, looking excited while a crowd watches.

story_beats.headline: A Shift in Targets
story_beats.speech: Wait, why is the calibration dial spinning toward the price board instead of my juicy prize tomatoes?
story_beats.label: The Glitch
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically reaches out to grab a spinning dial on his brass robot-slicer as green laser signals shoot toward a large wooden price sign overhead.

story_beats.headline: The Red Rain
story_beats.speech: Duck everyone! It is slicing the giant prize-winning tomatoes right off the display shelf at high velocity!
story_beats.label: The Chaos
story_beats.visual_prompt: Market vendors duck behind wooden crates as sliced tomatoes fly through the air like miniature airborne projectiles, with the robot smoking in the center.

story_beats.headline: Salad for Everyone
story_beats.speech: Well, on the bright side, we accidentally made the biggest communal salsa in the history of the town.
story_beats.label: The Result
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby and smiling market vendors stand ankle-deep in a giant bowl of fresh salsa outside a wooden market stall, holding tortilla chips.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful stop-motion claymation aesthetic with expressive character animations.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric middle-aged inventor with wild gray hair, wearing a striped green vest, oversized goggles on his forehead, and carrying a clipboard.

locations.market_square: A bustling town market filled with wooden stalls, colorful awnings, and hanging vegetable baskets under a bright sunny sky.

objects.robot_slicer: A bulky, whirring brass machine with multiple mechanical arms, a glowing green calibration dial, and a spinning steel blade attachment.

story.title: The Weaver's Last Loom
story.question: Can true friendship survive an impossible choice between personal ambition and village survival?
story.answer: Yes, but only when both friends realize that their shared heritage matters more than individual legacy.

story_beats.headline: Discovery of the Hidden Thread
story_beats.speech: Look closely at this ancient warp, master weaver. It holds patterns our ancestors thought were completely lost to time.
story_beats.label: The Ancient Forest Cache
story_beats.visual_prompt: Anxious master weaver Marcus holding a decaying wooden spindle inside a shadowy oak grove, wearing rugged earth-toned wool tunics, staring in wide-eyed shock at a glowing emerald moss patch.

story_beats.headline: The Impossible Mandate
story_beats.speech: We must choose right now whether to weave the royal banner for glory or keep our wool for the starving villagers.
story_beats.label: The Village Workshop
story_beats.visual_prompt: Resolute weaver Elian standing inside a cramped timber cottage doorway, clutching a bundle of coarse brown sheep's wool, pointing firmly toward the heavy oak threshold.

story_beats.headline: Breaking the Traditional Loom
story_beats.speech: If we destroy our only working frame today, the tax collector will punish us both severely before the winter frost arrives.
story_beats.label: The Burning Yard
story_beats.visual_prompt: Marcus tossing a glowing brass lantern onto a pile of carved wooden weaving shuttles in the muddy cobblestone courtyard, casting long dramatic orange flames against stone walls.

story_beats.headline: A New Foundation
story_beats.speech: We have no grand tapestries left to sell, but our people are warm, fed, and standing safely together.
story_beats.label: The River Wharf
story_beats.visual_prompt: Elian and Marcus smiling shoulder to shoulder on a wooden trading barge loaded with sacks of grain, watching the village green fade away under a clear morning sky.

visual_bible.style: Realistic historical drama with rich textures, earthy color palettes, and cinematic natural lighting.

characters.Marcus: A tall, broad-shouldered weaver with weathered hands, short dark hair, deep worry lines, wearing a dark green wool tunic and leather apron.
characters.Elian: A nimble, sharp-eyed artisan with a braided blonde beard, wearing a russet linen shirt and trousers patched with sturdy grey denim.

locations.The Ancient Forest Cache: A damp, mossy clearing surrounded by towering ancient oak trees with thick twisting roots.
locations.The Village Workshop: A modest stone cottage filled with dusty shelves, scattered yarn, and the wooden skeleton of a broken loom.
locations.The Burning Yard: A muddy cobblestone courtyard enclosed by low stone walls and timber fences.
locations.The River Wharf: A rustic wooden dock extending into a calm river, with moored cargo barges tied by thick hemp ropes.

objects.Spindle: A hand-carved walnut wood spindle wrapped in shimmering golden thread that catches the ambient light.
objects.Wool Bundle: A thick, coarse bundle of raw, unwashed brown sheep wool tied securely with coarse twine.
objects.Brass Lantern: A dented, soot-stained brass oil lantern with a cracked glass chimney and a glowing wick.
objects.Grain Sack: A large burlap sack marked with a dark red dye stamp, overflowing slightly with pale golden wheat grains.

story.title: The Great Saltmarsh Wind-Catcher Regatta
story.question: How do you win a seaside race without an engine?
story.answer: By building a tide-powered paddle craft that uses underwater buoyancy flutes to march across the surf.

story_beats.headline: Tidal Discovery
story_beats.speech: Look at how the heavy undertow rushes past the pier pilings. We can harness that steady underwater pulse directly.
story_beats.label: Low Tide Secret
story_beats.visual_prompt: At the coastal boardwalk, Captain Bram wearing a weathered green oilskin coat points a brass spyglass toward the rushing sea channel while his apprentice Maeve stands nearby holding a carved wooden buoyancy valve.

story_beats.headline: Building the Flutes
story_beats.speech: We must fit these weighted copper chambers precisely so they compress whenever the incoming saltwater swells upward against them.
story_beats.label: Workshop Assembly
story_beats.visual_prompt: Inside the boathouse workshop, Captain Bram in his green oilskin coat uses a riveting hammer to attach polished copper tubes to the wooden hull while Maeve holds a heavy leather bellows.

story_beats.headline: The Mechanical Pulse
story_beats.speech: When the wave pressure triggers the release lever, the piston drives the stern paddles forward without touching the wind.
story_beats.label: Valve Test
story_beats.visual_prompt: At the water's edge, Maeve wearing a patchwork canvas apron pulls a braided rope lever, causing mechanical brass paddles on the underside of the vessel to snap outward rhythmically.

story_beats.headline: Victory on the Waves
story_beats.speech: Our underwater engine never relied on the breeze at all. See how it smoothly overtakes every stalled sailing boat?
story_beats.label: Finish Line
story_beats.visual_prompt: On the sunlit festival bay, Captain Bram and Maeve stand proudly aboard their humming paddle vessel as it crosses beneath the beribboned judges pavilion, leaving traditional sailboats behind.

visual_bible.style: Bright coastal illustration with rich textures, warm sunlight, and detailed Victorian engineering elements.

characters.Captain Bram: An elderly salt-of-the-earth shipwright with a bushy white beard, deep laugh lines, wearing a weathered dark green oilskin coat and a woolen cap.
characters.Maeve: A sharp-eyed young apprentice with auburn hair tied in a practical braid, wearing a durable patchwork canvas apron over a blue linen shirt.

locations.Boardwalk Pier: A weathered timber pier extending over choppy green seawater, lined with colorful festival banners and brass railings.
locations.Boathouse Workshop: A cluttered maritime workshop filled with hanging ropes, wooden planks, brass fittings, and shelves of spare tools.

objects.spyglass: A tarnished brass extending telescope with leather grip rings.
objects.buoyancy valve: A carved cedar wood cylinder with adjustable interior copper flaps.
objects.riveting hammer: A heavy steel mallet with a polished hickory wood handle.
objects.paddle vessel: A flat-bottomed oak craft fitted with interconnected brass pistons and underwater paddle wheels.
